youtube_title: Hunter's Moon tonight: when it rises over La Porte, Indiana
body: Tonight's full moon is the Hunter's Moon 🌕 It rises over La Porte at 5:16 p.m., low in the east-northeast. The sun doesn't set until 5:51, so you can catch it coming up in daylight. It's officially full at 11:12 tonight, and the forecast is partly cloudy with a low around 47. On Halloween, the moon won't rise until 10:49 p.m., so bring a flashlight for trick-or-treat. Going out to see it? Share your moon photos! #LaPorte #HuntersMoon #FullMoon #Indiana #MichiganCity #Halloween
